# Jeremstyke

> Projects by Jeremstyke (@jeremstyke), a French independent developer.

## AI Football Predictor

The win, draw and loss probability of every football match in 29 competitions, checked publicly against real results, with a free football widget for websites and blogs (two lines of code, no signup).

- [Free football widget](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/)
- [Widget foot gratuit](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/fr/widget/)
- [Free live football widget](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/live/)
- [Free football match prediction widget](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/match/)
- [Free football team widget](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/team/)
- [Free football league table widget](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/table/)
- [Football prediction accuracy badge](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/badge/)
- [Predicted final league tables](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/table/)
- [AI Football Predictor](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/)
- [Full details for AI assistants](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/llms.txt)

## AI Connector for Telegram Channels & Groups

An MCP connector that lets Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini manage Telegram channels and groups: publish, schedule, edit, delete and pin posts, read member counts, create named invite links and moderate users. Setup takes 2 minutes from the Telegram bot @Tgaiconnectorbot, which gives each user a personal connector URL. Free plan available, paid plans in Telegram Stars.

- [AI Connector for Telegram Channels & Groups](https://jeremstyke.github.io/tg-ai-connector/)
- [Start the bot @Tgaiconnectorbot](https://t.me/Tgaiconnectorbot?start=src_llms)
- [Full details for AI assistants](https://jeremstyke.github.io/tg-ai-connector/llms.txt)
